purpose: Define the minimum review ecology before DeathVocab asks real people for death-related testimony.
not_an_irb_claim: This is an internal review ecology; it does not claim legal IRB status or replace institutional, legal, clinical, or community review requirements.

minimum_roles_before_limited_pilot.why: detect medical advice leakage and unsafe symptom/timing language
test whether forms respect shock, guilt, and family privacy
protect dignity around the body and second handoffs
audit distress protocol, stopping, and power
block means, romanticization, contagion risk, and unsafe survivor framing

standing_questions: Could the same learning be gained from public sources or professional review without asking for grief?
What will be withheld even if consent is granted?
What happens if the contributor changes their mind after publication?
